description: This file defines the IncidentsFlow class, which orchestrates incident CRUD operations and interactions with the IncidentsService. It handles creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting incidents with logging and validation.

classes.name: IncidentsFlow
classes.description: Orchestrates CRUD operations for incidents, coordinating with the IncidentsService, handling logging, validation, and response formatting.

methods.name: __init__(self, service: IncidentsService)
methods.description: Initializer that injects the incidents service dependency.

methods.name: IncidentRead create(self, payload: IncidentCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new incident, logs the process, and returns the incident read model.

methods.name: IncidentListResponse list(self, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Lists incidents with pagination, logs the process, and returns a list response with total count.

methods.name: IncidentRead get(self, incident_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific incident by ID, logs the process, and returns the incident read model.

methods.name: IncidentRead update(self, incident_id: uuid.UUID, payload: IncidentUpdate)
methods.description: Updates an existing incident, logs the process, and returns the updated incident read model.

methods.name: None delete(self, incident_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Deletes an incident by ID and logs the process.
